lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
To! My sister is married to a teacher.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.

quiz.stem: My sister is married ___ a teacher.

native.hook: ใช้ to หลัง married!
native.tip: ไทยพูด “แต่งงานกับ” จึงมักใช้ with แต่อังกฤษใช้ to: “married to a doctor”
native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “She is married with a doctor.” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยพูดว่า “แต่งงานกับหมอ” จึงมักใช้ with แต่ภาษาอังกฤษใช้ to: “She is married to a doctor.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite
native.comment: เฉลย: “to” จำไว้ให้ดีนะ! ลองพูดประโยคนี้ออกเสียงดัง ๆ หนึ่งครั้ง แล้วฝึกเพิ่มฟรีได้ที่นี่: {link}

en.tip: Thai says married with, but English says married to: “married to a doctor”
en.caption: Do you say “She is married with a doctor”? 😅 Thai says married with, but English says married to. Say “She is married to a doctor”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
